messages:
From: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@google.com>

Cc: GCP Partner Enablement <gcp-partners@google.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: GCP Marketplace next steps for CloudCo listing

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the intro call with CloudCo last week. The partner team reviewed the integration plan and we'd like to align on procurement and billing flow before we move the listing to production. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm whether Redwood will use CloudCo-managed billing (third-party billing) or Redwood-managed listing with marketplace billing passthrough.
- Provide a short procurement path (PO vs. invoice cadence) and any internal approvals required for Marketplace SKUs.
- Share the completed onboarding checklist and any security/compliance artifacts required by GCP procurement.

I've attached our quick onboarding list to this email for reference. Can we get a mutual action plan by EOD Wednesday PST?

Best,
Priya Reddy
Partner Programs, Google Cloud

Attachments: gcp_onboarding_quicklist.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwood.example.com
To: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@google.com>, Arjun Mehta <arjun.mehta@cloudco.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com, kimberly_park@redwood.example.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace next steps for CloudCo listing

Hi Priya / Arjun —

Thanks — looping in Lauren (bizops) and Kimberly (finance/legal) to map the exact procurement path. Quick answers up front:

- Redwood prefers to publish as a Marketplace listing with third-party billing enabled so CloudCo can consolidate billing, but we are flexible if CloudCo wants Redwood-managed billing for transactable SKUs.
- Typical procurement path is PO -> Net 30 invoice from Redwood (for Redwood-managed) or customer billed by CloudCo (if third-party). If CloudCo requires Net 60 or specific invoice fields we can accommodate but will need legal sign-off.

Attaching our onboarding checklist as a starting point and a draft redline of the listing contract. Kimberly — would you review the redlines and flag any non-starters? Lauren — can you help map the internal PO steps we should share with CloudCo’s procurement?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx; vendor_contract_redline_v2.pdf

From: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 12:45:00 -0800

Ben / Lauren —

I reviewed the redline. Main items to confirm with CloudCo before we sign:

1) Billing terms: if CloudCo requires Redwood to accept billing reconciliation via CloudCo, we need a clear indemnity clause and a monthly remittance schedule.
2) Data residency & logs: CloudCo expects logs retention alignment with their SOC 2 policy. We need to confirm whether Redwood Dedicated/Private options will be referenced on the SKU.
3) Support SLA: If CloudCo lists a 99.9% SLA in the marketplace tile, we should ensure Dedicated capacity or SLA credits are scoped into the contract.

I'll mark the contract PDF with inline comments and propose a minimal set of amendments. Lauren — can you draft the PO flow diagram (steps, required fields, approver groups) so we can send a single doc to CloudCo procurement?

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Hi Priya / Arjun —

Attached is the PO flow diagram and a short procurement aide for CloudCo procurement teams. Key notes:

- For third-party billing: CloudCo will need to send a signed Marketplace reseller agreement and confirm the billing account ID. No PO required on Redwood side; CloudCo will collect payment and remit per reseller terms.
- For Redwood-managed billing: CloudCo can issue a PO referencing the SKU and the HubSpot deal id (RDW-4521). Required PO fields: legal name, billing address, PO number, contact person, and desired billing frequency. We support Net 30 by default.
- If CloudCo requests Net 60, finance needs an approval ticket; that typically adds 7 business days.

Requesting CloudCo procurement to confirm preferred billing model and attach their standard reseller agreement if they want third-party billing.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: PO_flow_diagram.pdf

Thanks everyone — this is helpful. CloudCo's procurement prefers third-party billing to keep a single vendor relationship. Attached is our reseller agreement (I'll send via DocuSign later). Two quick clarifications before DocuSign:

- We need Redwood to confirm the billing account ID format and a sample invoice line item for the SKU so our AP system can map categories properly.
- We also require the Data Processing addendum (DPAs) referenced in the contract. Can Redwood share the standard DPA doc?

Priya — once Redwood confirms those two items we can route the reseller agreement for signatures. Looking forward to launching the listing in January.

Best,
Arjun Mehta
Head of Partnerships, CloudCo
